title: Sign-in
intro: The server's environment is the ceiling: here you can only turn a sign-in method off and take people or domains off its lists. Adding anything needs a stack update. Every change needs you to confirm it with your password or a passkey, ends the sessions that no longer qualify, and is shown to every admin.
unreadable: The saved policy could not be read, so the environment applies. Save it again to fix it.
nothingNarrowed: Nothing narrowed yet: the environment applies.

methods.title: Ways to sign in
methods.emailLinksHelp: Codes and links go by email to every account. Off by default.
methods.offIn_email: off in this server: no email channel
methods.googleHelp: For people who linked a Google account, in the Socio app or on this website. Works while this server is connected to Socio’s cloud services.
methods.appleHelp: For people who linked an Apple account, in the Socio app or on this website. Works while this server is connected to Socio’s cloud services.

lists.ceiling: The environment ({{env}}) sets who can be here; untick to take someone off.
lists.empty: {{env}} lists nobody, so there is nothing to narrow.
lists.providersHelp: OAuth and OpenID Connect providers on the sign-in screen.
lists.adminEmailsHelp: Verified emails that are always admins. Taking one off makes that person a member at their next request, unless their own role is admin.
lists.allowedEmailsHelp: Who may create their own account through a provider.
lists.allowedDomainsHelp: Email domains whose people may create their own account through a provider.

mockAuth: This server signs in with the local picker (mock auth), so there are no sign-in methods to narrow.
codeAccess: Who may run code is now a permission: admins have it, and others get it from a group under <groupsLink>People → Groups</groupsLink>.

impact.signsYouOut: This signs you out: sign in again another way.
impact.withoutWayIn: Left without a way to sign in: {{people, list}}.
impact.codeRunsStopped_one: {{count, number}} queued or running code run will stop.
impact.codeRunsStopped_other: {{count, number}} queued or running code runs will stop.

confirm.title: Confirm the change
confirm.description: Every change to sign-in needs you to confirm it is you. Every admin is told about it.
confirm.saved: Access policy saved; every admin was told.

errors.load: Could not load the access policy.
